browse.title: Alpha Zoo
browse.subtitle: {{total}} pre-built quant alphas across 4 zoos
browse.description: Browse formula-driven cross-sectional signals from Qlib, the Kakushadze 101 set, GTJA 191, and the academic anomaly literature. Click any alpha to read its formula and source code, or run a bench to score the whole zoo on a universe and period.
browse.noMatch: No alphas match the current filters.
browse.selectHint: Tick 2+ alphas below, then compare them head-to-head

bench.title: Benchmark runner
bench.heading: Score a zoo on a universe
bench.description: Computes IC / IR for every alpha in the selected zoo over the chosen universe and period, then bucketizes them as alive / reversed / dead.

compareView.title: Compare alphas side by side
compareView.description: Benches just the alphas you pick on a universe and period, then ranks them by IC / IR with the gap to the leader — far faster than benching a whole zoo when you only care about a shortlist.
compareView.idsHint: Separate ids with commas or spaces. Tip: tick alphas in the catalogue and hit "Compare" to prefill this.
compareView.enterAtLeast2: Enter at least 2 distinct alpha ids to compare.

compareResult.icPositiveRatioTitle: Share of periods with positive IC

qlib158.description: Microsoft Qlib's full 158-feature library covering momentum, volatility, volume and rolling statistical signals.

alpha101.description: The 101 formulaic alphas from Kakushadze (2015); short-horizon cross-sectional signals.

gtja191.description: Guotai Junan Securities' 191 alphas; technical and microstructure signals tuned to China A-share markets.

academic.description: Curated long-horizon anomalies from the academic literature (value, momentum, quality, low-vol, etc.).
